calls.title: Growthbook <> Cape - Demo
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around GrowthBook's feature flagging and experimentation platform, highlighting its capabilities for controlled rollouts and data-driven insights tailored for web and mobile applications. GrowthBook allows for complex configurations and targeted releases while ensuring safety through programmatic API access and automatic rollback features. Insights from experiments and A/B testing were emphasized for understanding user metrics and segmenting data. Cape's preference for managed deployment options and structured communication was also noted, focusing on privacy compliance and security. Initial testing will occur in development environments to validate infrastructure before proceeding with broader deployment plans.
calls.keywords: Feature flagging, Managed warehouse, Mobile SDK, Data privacy, Experimentation, Infrastructure connectivity

calls.title: Growthbook <> Cape - Pricing Review
calls.summary: GrowthBook's Daniel Wathne and Cape's Nathan Mayer reviewed GrowthBook's pricing model (flat platform fee plus per-seat cost, no usage limits) and discussed potential seat discounts, but Nathan declined co-marketing due to security concerns. Nathan, the key decision-maker (with Kenzie as another stakeholder), noted the cost was unbudgeted and requested any discount to simplify approval. Next steps: Daniel will discuss with Kenzie about possibly starting with 25 seats for a volume discount, and Nathan will loop back internally.

calls.title: Growthbook <> Cape - Check In
calls.summary: The team has agreed to proceed with contract execution, setting a mid-July initiation aim for a start date around the 15th. Dan Wathne will coordinate with the AWS representative for submission by early next week. Communication channels for onboarding have been established, with Dan as the primary contact, while August and Natasha lead post-sales support. The Proof of Concept (PoC) has been validated, allowing for smooth contract signing and deployment planning. Kense Ning will manage internal updates and align communications with product leadership. Additionally, a dedicated support structure has been integrated to enhance client experiences, including training sessions to facilitate smooth onboarding and mitigate potential challenges.
